entries.title: Isaiah 60:1
segments: Arise, shine; for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD has risen on you.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:2
segments: For behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness [the] peoples; but the LORD shall rise on you, and His glory shall be seen on you.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:3
segments: And the nations shall come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your dawning.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:4
segments: Lift up your eyes all around, and see. All of them gather themselves; they come to you. Your sons shall come from far, and your daughters shall be nursed at [your] side.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:5
segments: Then you shall fear and become bright, and your heart shall throb and swell for joy; because the abundance of the sea shall turn to you, the wealth of the nations will come to you.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:6
segments: A host of camels shall cover you, the camels of Midian and Ephah. All of them from Sheba shall come; they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall proclaim the praises of the LORD.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:7
segments: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together to you; the rams of Nebaioth shall minister to you. They shall come up on My altar pleasing Me, and I will glorify the house of My glory.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:8
segments: Who [are] these [who] fly like a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?

entries.title: Isaiah 60:9
segments: Surely the coastlands shall wait for Me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring your sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, to the name of the LORD your God, and to the Holy One of Israel, because He has glorified you.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:10
segments: And the sons of strangers will build up your walls, and their kings will serve you; for in My wrath I struck you, but in My favor I had mercy on you.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:11
segments: Therefore your gates will always be open; they will not be shut day nor night, to bring to you the wealth of the nations, and their kings may be led.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:12
segments: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve you will perish. Yes, [those] nations will be completely wasted.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:13
segments: The glory of Lebanon will come to you, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box tree together, to beautify the place of My sanctuary; and I will make the place of My feet glorious.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:14
segments: Also the sons of your afflicters shall come bowing to you; and all your despisers will bow down at the soles of your feet. And they will call you, The city of the LORD, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:15
segments: Instead of being forsaken and hated, so that no one passes through, I will make you for everlasting majesty, a joy of many generations.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:16
segments: You will also suck the milk of nations, and suck the breast of kings; and you will know that I the LORD [am] your Savior and your Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:17
segments: For bronze I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver; and for wood I will bring bronze, and for stones, iron. I will also make your overseers to be peace, and your rulers to be righteousness.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:18
segments: Violence will no more be heard in your land, wasting nor ruin within your borders; but you will call your walls Salvation, and your gates Praise.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:19
segments: The sun will no more be your light by day; nor the brightness of the moon give light to you; but the LORD will be to you for everlasting light, and your God your glory.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:20
segments: Your sun will no more go down, nor your moon withdraw; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and the days of your mourning will be ended.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:21
segments: Your people also [will] all [be] righteous; they will inherit the land forever, the branch of My planting, the work of My hands, so that I may be glorified.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:22
segments: A little one will become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I the LORD will hasten it in its time.
